rv.q: Lee's terrifying descent is sensitively handled, brutally honest and refreshingly unsentimental.

Imagine your worst fear has come true and the world is going to hell in a handcart with a deadly virus that spreads so fast it is impossible to keep up with. In desperation, you would try to find somewhere to escape the prospect of being infected. Actually, we had all that a few years ago with the Covid epidemic.
The main problem is that, like the Survivor, there often seems to be nowhere for the music or the story to go.
This is a production with really great intent that doesn't quite hit the mark.
Unfortunately even a fantastic performance can't redeem a piece with no content.
